Hi Soojin — thanks for the note.

Quick update: the inbound vessel experienced a berthing delay in Seattle due to congestion; the container with Pallet A-1227 cleared customs inspection this morning but customs flagged a missing Certificate of Origin (COO) for the electronics in the crate. Without COO, Customs will not release the container to dray for final delivery.

We have the following options:
1) Provide a COO and we can request immediate release and schedule dray same-day (subject to available trucks).
2) If COO is not provided, the container will remain on terminal custody (storage fees apply) and the earliest dray could be Aug 24–25 depending on slot availability.

I don't yet see the COO in the documents you attached. If you can email the COO (or authorize Dev to sign the attestation), we can push for same-day release.

Tracking URL: https://tracking.harbordray.com/track?ref=BOL_98765

Best,
